results.answer: The Code of Conduct's Network and access section says: “Employees are assigned rights to access and process information, which is appropriate for the execution of their employees.” [S1] “For the exceptions, employees are required to obtain approvals from both their competent managers and IT Department.” [S1] “Unauthorized access and processing will be treated as an act of infringement of property of VINAMILK.” [S1] The Code separately refers to the Information System Policy: “The Company stipulates the usage and protection of the Information System in Information System Policy.” [S4] The separate Information System Policy is not included in the retrieved documents; this answer covers only the Code of Conduct provisions [S4].

limitations: This is a single authenticated admin run over the public Vinamilk corpus; it is not a role-matrix test.
Supported and unsupported outcomes have deterministic route, source, value, abstention and result-shape checks.
Partial HR, compliance and executive cases still need blinded semantic review; these labels do not prove private-domain capability.
